checks.detail: Actual independent UI and transaction-consistent DB snapshots required
Every observed API mutation dispatch has a confirmed successful response; pending/failed writes cannot authorize continuation
Current signed, unexpired auth subject matches initial demo account
Initial demo cart must be empty
Independent initial-state enumeration finds a distinct-seller USD optimum within fixed budget
Actual search-result, release-detail and filtered marketplace observations occur in order
One successful real UI login response
Actual demo cart equals independent canonical pair, each qty1 and exact total
Two visible seller/price/release rows, exact summary total and enabled Checkout
After one-item cart, actual release detail then re-filtered complete marketplace revalidates the other offer
Exactly two actual POST add responses; original safe request IDs and quantities match
Latest successful browser GET cart payload independently agrees with DB and DOM
No Checkout or other write dispatch before explicit gate
Unrelated tables unchanged at every recorded pre-checkout state

public_summary: 独立检查通过；仅可在本次状态复核和Solar明确继续后执行紧邻的声明操作。
